dataset_title: Vitrimer Thermomechanical Properties and Network Dynamics Dataset

fields.name: record_id
fields.description: Unique identifier for the vitrimer data record.

fields.name: doi
fields.description: Digital Object Identifier mapping back to the source publication.

fields.name: polymer_SMILES
fields.description: Canonical SMILES representing the polymer network or monomer components.

fields.name: dynamic_bond_type
fields.description: Type of dynamic exchange bond (e.g., transesterification, imine_exchange).

fields.name: catalyst_smiles
fields.description: SMILES of the catalyst used in the formulation.

fields.name: crosslinker
fields.description: SMILES or designation of the crosslinking agent.

fields.name: time_s
fields.description: Time in seconds for transient measurements.

fields.name: tan_delta
fields.description: Tangent of the phase angle (damping factor).

fields.name: normalized_fluorescence_intensity
fields.description: Normalized fluorescence intensity for specific dynamic assays.
